details.note: Unchanged (w19A r18/r19 diff 0.75 % px, all on surface detail). LE sweep, rake and tip lift still match KN41 / _7331.

details.detail: Surface detail: value, panel tone, seams, fastener rows, slat band, gear stripe, placards, grime
details.note: Smudge heads now start as a point: darkest pixel 106-107 on 163 (0.65) at the hinge end, but the body is still a flat 127-128 block ~8 px long (z_w19A_r19). Fastener dots: w19A row 500 158 on 168 (r18 159), still 0.94 vs KN41 0.80, though they read as discrete dots now rather than a line. No ladders.

Crown ripple gone: s13A top silhouette 255..240 monotonic (r18 had a 240->243->249 bump), w13A crown smooth. Flank foot step to the cowl reduced from +38-40 L to +20-28 L (w13A x 480-600: flank 161-165, cowl 185-193). New: the steeper nose (sqrt(smooth(1.65,2.3))) gives a flat-topped plateau (c_nacelle_left top row 22 constant over x 400-470) ending in a corner and a chamfered front (rows 26/29/38/48/67), where _137's dome is rounded; and with hB^1.6 the saddle has disappeared (silhouette rises monotonically from strut to dome), while _137 shows a shallow notch between dome and rise.

details.detail: Nacelle geometry (cowl, lip, splits, strake, access panel)
details.note: Hinge hairline FIXED in tone and extent: w13A minima along the line 103-167 on 173-199 (mean ~0.75 of the cowl, r18 51-131 = 0.30), meets both splits in c_nacelle_left / z_pyl_r19. The 5 mm tube is sub-pixel at 13A, so it breaks into light dashes (minima alternate 120/160 every ~6 px); at 1x this is faint and acceptable.

FIXED mostly: w11K fan end row 420 66 -> 52 (end pixel 41), row 360 63 -> 49, row 350 58 -> 51; knav _9 ~10-52, so now at the top of the photo range. w11A lip end unchanged 124-136 (held). Spinner still barely readable from seats.
Black aliased hinge stroke gone (now light, mildly dashed). Remaining: the pylon dome-front corner, the flat smudge body. No z-fighting, gaps or floating parts.
